declared_differences.INT_TAG: a cell of a column declared Int64 holds a non-negative value: the reference tags it int64, the engine derives the tag from the value (uint64 when it is not negative); the value is identical
declared_differences.FLOAT_ULP: a float64 cell the reference computed from a 64-bit pattern (method_numbers.double_value) is up to one unit in the last place from the exact reading of the pattern, which the engine returns
declared_differences.ORDER: a relation read without ORDER BY has no promised order; the engine keeps the stable order named for each relation, the reference's depends on its query plan; the rows are the same multiset
declared_differences.NON_SCALAR: the plain UTF-8 relations refuse a DEX holding a legal non-scalar string; the reference substitutes text
declared_differences.STRICT_INPUT: a DEX in which two class definitions share one class_data_item is refused at open; the reference reads it
declared_differences.COLUMN_TYPE_OF_EMPTY_RESULT: the type the engine reports for a result column is taken from the values, so a column with no value or only NULLs is reported 'unknown'; the reference reports the declared type
declared_differences.DYNAMIC_COLUMNS: owner_kind, parameter_idx and retention_policy are computed columns the reference types 'sqlite_dynamic'; the engine types them by their values
declared_differences.A0_PAGING_DEFECT: reading code_items of a DEX with a code item no method declares, or type_lists of a DEX with a type list nothing refers to, the reference counts the item and delivers no page (next_offset stays); the engine answers code_items with the method-bound items (none here) and type_lists with every list of the section
declared_differences.REFERENCE_INCOMPLETE: type_list_entries of a type list nothing refers to: the reference has no entries for it, the engine lists them; every row the reference delivers is the engine's too (two fixtures)
declared_differences.LOCAL_PATH: dex_files.source_path is the path the input was opened from and differs by machine; it is not compared

declared_open_refusals.shared-class-data: two class definitions share one class_data_item; the engine refuses the DEX (INVALID_INPUT), the reference reads it

sql_surface: each relation is exercised by SELECT * paged to the end; the 17 contract relations are additionally exercised by the MDD-035 corpus (joins, aggregates, CTEs, ORDER BY). General SQL over the 39 others is not claimed beyond what the query layer proves for any relation.
special_formats: no relation here depends on DEX 041, compact DEX, OAT or VDEX; those keep their own capability matrix (compatibility/ledger.json format_qualifications)
